Today, “UNDERWARD” has received a massive update!
The update is titled "UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor"!!
This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is so large in scale that you might think, “Isn’t this practically a new game?”
“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode spanning 6 floors.
In addition to the abandoned hospital, three new maps have been added—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—each with multiple variations that appear randomly.
Difficulty levels can also be chosen from “NORMAL,” “HARD,” and “ABYSS,” offering plenty of variety and replayability.

releases.displayName: Massive Update Launches for Free on September 24!!

items.text: On September 24, a massive update is coming to UNDERWARD!
The update is titled: 『UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor』!!
This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is packed with so much content that you might think: “Isn’t this basically a new release?”
“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode consisting of 6 floors.
In addition to the existing abandoned hospital, three new maps with multiple variations—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—will be added, appearing randomly during play.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/d5004c19abc6ee278cfb5d581cd12f61632e06e0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/af56672e77d03c417236a385d1539ed87b0cad9f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9409304dba5b79428f97b64273c12c2b951671b0.jpg"]

notes.title: ◆ A Play Experience of Both Tension and Laughter

items.text: This update especially emphasizes the B-movie horror panic vibe, while also adding plenty of party-game-style elements where everyone can laugh and go wild together.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/f241c5e17168b6b7b31130cf01278fd619ced259.gif"]
Many new enemies, quirky funny items, and unique mechanics have been added, making strategies and ways to enjoy the game increase dramatically! (approx. +200% compared to before)
To make the game enjoyable for a wider range of players, we’ve added the ability for players to customize game rules.

You can go for lighthearted fun with settings like “Respawn: Infinite” & “Time Limit: Long,” or go hardcore with punishing settings like “Enemy Respawn Time: Short” and “Rescue Time: None” to push the limits of challenge.
※ This rule customization feature is also available in the default mode.

notes.title: ◆ Free Update! But We Need to Adjust the Price…

※ We kindly ask for your understanding, as this is part of what allows us to continue developing the game.

notes.title: Fixed an issue where the game would crash on startup for PCs that do not support FSR

items.text: In the previous update, we changed the upscaling feature (FSR) to be enabled by default to improve performance. However, we received reports that this caused crashes on startup for players using PCs that do not support FSR.
To address this issue, we have applied a fix in update patch v1.0.3.1, which reverts the default setting of FSR to OFF.
If you are experiencing crashes on startup, please check that you have updated to the latest version and try launching the game again.
While this patch should resolve startup crashes, enabling FSR in the options menu (e.g., by changing the Quality Preset settings) may still cause crashes in environments where FSR is not supported.
If your system crashes when using FSR, please avoid using the Quality Preset feature and adjust the settings manually.

(Note: FSR has been confirmed to work correctly with GPUs that meet the minimum system requirements listed on the store page, but performance may vary depending on individual system configurations. We appreciate your understanding.)
That concludes this update.
We will continue working on updates to make the game even more enjoyable, and we truly appreciate your support!
